default.notes: A visa is issued on arrival at Funafuti for a stay of up to one month, against a fee usually quoted at AUD 100 in cash, a passport valid 6 months, an onward ticket, booked accommodation and proof of funds. Some official sources describe this simply as visa-free entry for 30 days — either way the permission is granted at the airport.

groups.notes: Visa exemption for EU, EEA, Swiss and Serbian passports — up to 90 days within any 180-day period.

Visa issued on arrival at Funafuti free of charge for up to one month — Commonwealth and Pacific nationalities pay no fee, but still need a passport valid 6 months, an onward ticket and booked accommodation.

TV.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Tuvaluan citizens.

TW.notes: Taiwanese passport holders are visa-exempt for up to 90 days — Taiwan is one of Tuvalu's closest diplomatic partners.
